nom: The Ordinary Matrixyl 10% + Hyaluronic Acid for Fine Lines and Wrinkles

avis.texte: I've been using this for a few years because it has broken up my dynamic wrinkles and helped my fine lines. One bottle lasts one month. Since it works, and has a great price point, I will always repurchase this. It's also hydrating.

I am almost 54 yrs old and have found this product AMAZING! Makes my skin look so bright and smooth! After using this product 2 months, I've been asked several times if I've lost weight...which I have not...I just think it has smoothed out my face to the point people see something different and aren't sure what it is! 😆

I've purchased many other ordinary product skin care items in my mid 30s. I started to experience extremely sensitive skin. I tried ordinary about two years ago and it works extremely well with my ultra sensitive skin. I thought I would test this product out since I restocked on my favorites. I noticed though it is pretty I mean well it's described as a strong product so I'm just using it lightly in certain areas and gotta go from there, I have been using for 2 weeks now nothing dramatic has happened to my face when I put it on compared to using other skincare products that are on the market. Like I mentioned I just barely started using it so it's really too soon to say if I will see results it'll take at least a month or two but for now I can say it's good on my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: I've been using this for a years
avis.texte: Helped break up my dynamic wrinkles. Quit for a few months to get used to tret and have now reintroduced it with no irritation. Great price point. I'll always buy this
Love the way this serum feels in my face and keeps the fine lines & wrinkles at bay.

Absolutely love! I use it before bed, after I wake up I touch my forehead and it feels sooo insanely plump, I've never had a product work this well... the standard hyaluronic + B5 is sticky and pills but this matrixyl hyaluronic doesn't have that problem

Swapped out my Timeless Matrixyl 3000 for this one after reading up on matrixyl types. The Ordinary's had both types I was looking for, at a fraction of the price. Pleasantly surprised by the formula, which is light, absorbs quickly, and has only a faint scent that reminds me of cold sake.

i have used a few things from the ordinary before but i decided to branch out and try something else they make. honestly im never disappointed w their products. i got this to trybecause i have a deep wrinkle from furrowing my brows a lot and my skin is so dull. instantly upon applying this serum brought life back to my skin giving a very plump glowy appearance. the wrinkle was almost none existent as well….. i apply after washing my face at night and i just pat into my skin. pair it with my LED beauty mask and two weekss later wrinkle is nonexistent and skin retains moisture better. love and will be repurchasing until the day i meave this earth!

I bought this after seeing a woman swear by a combo of Matrixyl and Argineline for fine line reduction. It is a peptide, so it works best when used consistently although it may have long term results without everyday use! Ive been using this combo once or twice daily for 6 months. The reduction in my fine lines is palpable. Please dont discountinue these ever < 3

avis.titre: A staple in my skin care
avis.texte: This product is amazing in eliminating fine lines and wrinkles. I use it daily along with other The Ordinary products, and see a substantial difference in my skin. The Ordinary products are very light weight and seep into the skin without pilling or leaving residue. I'm 74 y/o and have used many products, but none were as effective as this line of skin care. I am very impressed with the results from this line of skin care products.

I have used the plain HA without issue and decided to try this. Within a week, i am breaking out on both cheeks. I'm disappointed bc this product is actually less sticky than the plain HA once it dries and wont make my makeup pill the way HA alone does. Off to the drawing board for a different product

avis.titre: I want to really like this but
avis.texte: The matrixyl makes me break out. I really want to be able to use it but i can't I'm so sad about it.

avis.titre: Another home run from The Ordinary!
avis.texte: Again, my 2nd bottle of Matrixyl 10% + Hyaluronic Acid. I've added this into my daily skin care routine of The Ordinary skin care products. I put 2 drops into the palm of my hand and apply it to my face and neck with my fingertips. A little goes a long way. My skin looks tighter and healthier, so I am very pleased with this product. I use quite a few of The Ordinary products, and will be adding more of their products to my "cache". They are not inly affordable, but they produce the results I am looking for.
I found this to be very sticky/tacky. Used an entire bottle and saw no results. I could handle the stickiness if it worked, but 8 weeks later, nothing.

avis.titre: Been using this for idk five years?
avis.texte: One bottle lasts me one month. It's broken up my dynamic wrinkles and gotten rid of fine lines. I';; always repurchase this
This product, some sunscreen, a moisturizing cream, and vitamin c is my secret weapon! I have sensitive skin and this doesn't make my skin itchy or raw feeling. recommend trying for sure
Use this with Agreline, niaminicide and hylsuranic acid. Works so well to moisturize

I live in a desert climate and am always looking for ways to hydrate my thirsty skin. I stay away from hyaluronic acid because there's no moisture in the air to pull from but feel like most deeply hydrating products contain it. I got this after reading the reviews and already can't imagine my routine without it. I use it with the retinol, rose hip oil, and squalene in rotation and my skin looks and feels so much better in the mornings. It's not greasy at all and absorbs very quickly. I use it AM and PM and haven't had any negative reaction at all. No breakouts, no clogged pores, no redness. Love it!

avis.titre: A staple in my regimen for wrinkles
avis.texte: One bottle lasts me one month. I've used this for a couple of years, and it's broken up my dynamic lines and made fine lines disappear. Also is hydrating. I use this along with their growth factors and retinal (yellow stuff in a tube, not retinol)

avis.titre: I've been using this for a year bc it works
avis.texte: This, in combination with retinal and growth factors, has transformed my skin. One bottle lasts be about one month, and I'll never stop buying it.

In my mid forties. Only a couple weeks into using this once a day at night and my neck is noticeably firmer. Face seems plumper. I'm seeing some improvement in deeper facial lines as well, I believe longer use will show positive results.

avis.titre: Will repurchase for fine line improvement
avis.texte: I have using this with GF and Argireline and I believe it is improving fine lines on my 55 yr old skin.

I absolutely LOVE The Ordinary!!! With these inexpensive products, you can put together a personalized skin care regimen that meets your exact needs without paying for a lot of ingredients you probably don't need and/or going through some expensive customization service. I combine The Ordinary with COSRX Snail Mucin products and a Mario Badescu toner for the best results. Granted, my regimen consists of about a dozen products, so I could save time by spending more money, but the results I've gotten from the regimen I've put together are undeniable! My skin looks firmer, healthier, and younger. You HAVE to combing this with Argireline to get the advertised results. I use a fan to dry it after application. If used as directed, you will LOVE the results.
I love the ordinary! Always a great value for high quality stuff

I've used this serum for years and is one of the few skincare products that I automatically restock. Keeps my skin healthy, supported and hydrated. I use under a gel moisturizer in the winter and by itself in the summer. Plays nice with other skincare and makeup.

avis.titre: Love it and the price point!
avis.texte: This is my favorite serum! I've bought it repeatedly and have never experienced any irritation. It helps my skin stay healthy.

avis.titre: I purchase again and again and will never stop
avis.texte: This Matrixyl is a staple in my anti-age regimen. I use it twice/day (as it recommends) on my face, neck, and backs of my hands. One bottle lasts me a little over one month, broke up dynamic wrinkles and made fine lines disappear. HA hydrates well.
I don't know about the wrinkles but I do know that it is very moisturizing. I love the way my skin feels during and after application. My skin looks great. Thank you!

I saw this on Facebook recommended by a dermatologist. Was super excited and felt so nice on, but it made me break out and I don't even have oily skin. Definitely contact dermatitis/ allergic reaction.

I've been using this daily for about a month & don't see any results. It's cheap so not much of a loss. I find this formula to be very sticky. I despise sticky skincare. I think it's the HA. It actually accentuates the fine horizontal lines on my neck.
I enjoy using the Ordinary products including Matrixyl ingredients are simple but effective
I am 50 and have dry skin. I used this 2 days in a row and now have 17 pimples on my face. This is the inky oart of my routine i changed.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: This product is great and you have to give it time to use it to see the results
This stuff is breaking up my wrinkles and making fine lines disappear. I love it so much
Used this for 1 year and it helps plumps my skin and decrease wrinkles

I have been using this serum for years now. I absorbs well and feels so nice on the skin. It hydrates targeted areas and temporarily diminishes the look of fine wrinkles. I appreciate how inexpensive this serum is compared to similar products.

I'm 23 years old and for some reason have fine lines around my eyes from smiling. Ever since I used this product, those lines are GONE. It definitely smooths out all the lines and plumps the skin. Matrixyl is a very good and proven ingredient to boost collagen. 1 bottle lasted me 3 months. I'm very happy with it and will continue to purchase!

avis.titre: Working great for my 58yr old skin
avis.texte: I started using Matrixyl in Jan 2024 in AM only, so just over 4mths in. I love what it's doing for my skin, so far. It's a lovely light serum that works great with my moisturizer, sunscreen and makeup. I use niacinamide & retinal.02% at night (having stepped up slowly with lower retinoids) and the combination has really started giving results. I've recently had 3 totally random comments about how good my complexion looks (I've never had happen before)! I'm fair skinned with freckles and over the years gained sun damage, pigmentation, wrinkles, enlarged pores, breakouts and more! All of these latter issues are definitely improving - I wish I'd started this skincare regime years ago! I love The Ordinary products and im so glad I started using them.

Even though I just entered my 20s, I started getting forehead lines that are visible even when my face is at rest. This has been the only formula to soften my forehead lines and help with dehydration. The texture is also my favorite out of everything I use. It would be great if there were larger bottle options like with the niacinamide. I got through them like water.

I've been using this for the past 5 months and the difference it has made, especially on my neck, is nothing short of amazing! It has also helped firm my smokers lines, the area around my jaw line where, when your 54, tends to get little crinkled after being slept on overnight. The improvements have extended to the rest of my face but my neck and jawline have benefited the most. I will absolutely continue using it and recommend it to my friends and family.
I have tried different ordinary serums, but this one is the best so far. I love the texture and I have been seeing improvements in my lines.
Bought this to help treat wrinkles and this product has been great. It goes on smoothly and doesn't sting or bother my sensitive skin

avis.titre: B o t o x in a bottle
avis.texte: This stuff is softening my wrinkles and breaking them up. It's great to pair with the Argireline; this pair is in fact nicknamed "b o t o x in a bottle". It also complements what retinol does. I wait half an hour after application to put on my vitamin C

avis.titre: My favourite serum of them all!
avis.texte: I love this serum! I'm 49 and very blessed with not many craters just a few fine lines on forehead around eyes etc. This serum really does plump my face up and makes the lines appear less. I find after using it that my face feels smother to touch when I wash it. It should be noted that I use another brand night cream on top of while I sleep (but only as I already had this before I began shopping at The Ordinary - when I don't use this serum it doesn't have the same effect on my skin) In short, I prefer this serum to other more expensive ones on here - it works great for me! Please don't change it!

Well lets start by stating im 38 years old, i have lines, lots of microlines, i have the 11s and upper lip crinkle wrinkles, I brought this because its hard to find a budget serum with both matrixyl 3000 and matrixyl synth 6 in it and ive been using it for 3 months atm I probably should gibe it longer to be fair. I cant say im seeing huge differences but there is a difference, more so in my relaxed face. but its not enough for me. so yeah its a nice product but i think its more for entry level or young adults experiencing wrinkles, or maybe its just my skin not loving the formulation, give it a try, its cheap enough, get through a bottle and make a decision for yourself, but for me, i was nearly gas-lighting myself into believing it did more then it has because i didn't wanna pay more of another brand haha. I have to say though, its lovely to apply on the skin and works really well with argiraline and layers well too

It goes on well on top of my moisturizing oil. I only really use it once a day, and my pores look smaller, but I can't tell that it's working for my crows feet or any wrinkles near my eyes. My face is already plump, so that looks the same. I've been using the product for over a month. I may switch to a different serum.

Was said to work like wrinkle removing injections when mixed with argireline. Have been using for over a week as suggested and don't see a difference. There are other products that work 100% better in instantly reducing eye wrinkles try Peter Thomas Roth instead
I love this stuff ....omg no more pores ....I never really had wrinkles although I'm 40 ...but I will never stop using this stuff

Only been using for 10 days or so but can really see a difference straight away. My daughter even commented that my skin was looking good. It obviously doesn't get rid of wrinkles but my skin seems bouncier and less saggy (I'm 55 so that's great!!). Using it with the squalane cleanser, Tetraisopalmisate oil which does also brighten my skin, and the HA moisturiser. All round am really pleased and no breakouts as yet which I normally get if I change brands.

This has to be TO's most cosmetically elegant serum. It sinks in really nicely, isn't under- or overly-slippery, plays nicely with almost everything else, and hydrates so nicely. Surprising for a relatively simple formulation, but I suspect it's the balance of water, glycerin, and HA, besides the peptide complex. It's also unexpectedly soothing, great after shaving in my beard and neckline. I missed it after swapping out for the Multi Peptide and HA I was gifted. I use it with another brand's niacinamide serum (after letting it sink in for a few mins) and I've never had better skin. Has definitely improved the look of my face and I no longer get eczema on my forehead and neck since using it. Underrated for sure.
I have been using this for 2 years now. I can honestly say it has eradicated the wrinkles between my eyebrows and significantly reduced my crows feet. Great serum

avis.titre: I have used it before but now I am breaking out!
avis.texte: I think ordinary changed something in the formula for couple of their product. I got acne all over my face with using their serums. I am trying to return them but I have not heard back from them. So the problem started exactly the day after I add them to my routine. Nothing else is new and I have not used them all at once. I never add everything that I bought all together. I tried them one by one and couple of days in between. This was suppose to be a replacement for the pricy Vichy HA serum so I can use that less than every day.

If I could have only one skincare product, this would be it! I am completely obsessed with this serum. It goes on so smoothly, leaves my face completely moisturized, all while targeting my fine lines?! Crazy! I do think my fine lines look smoother (I don't think they have gotten thinner, or are vanishing, but definitely smoother). I also think this might give me a little glow?! Or maybe it's a placebo effect. I top it off with The Ordinary Daily Moisturizer + HA for a perfectly dewey look, and smooth skin all day!

First time user of The Ordinary line. I will forever be a customer! I love this brand of matrixyl. It makes my face feel wonderful and it goes great under your makeup. I can tell an improvement with my texture of my face and neck.
When I do a big smile, I have many smile wrinkles on my cheeks. I started using Matrixyl and they are gone! I love it!

I use The Ordinary skincare every day in my routine. I love these products. Each night, I use a mixture cocktail of serums which I put in my palm, rub together, then on my face. These are by far, my most used brand of skincare products. They've made a huge difference.

avis.titre: There are better options out there
avis.texte: I have bought this a few times in the past, but found it somewhat hard to layer due to the thick, kind of sticky consistency (which I believe is caused by the HA). It can pill and just feels a bit gross on the skin. I have found other Matrixyl products easier to use (in terms of layering), more comfortable and ones that absorb into the skin better, so I don't buy this anymore.

avis.titre: The WOW factor is in the house!
avis.texte: I just ordered this and only used it for the first time yesterday so I can't speak for the long term effects but my skin showed definite improvement almost immediately! It took a few minutes to sink in but the WOW was definitely there, my skin looked almost instantly refreshed and glowy and stayed that way until this morning when I reapplied it. I can't wait to use it in combination with the Argireline Serum which I also purchased after seeing a Youtube video explaining how to combine these products. At this price run don't walk, go grab some and see the difference for yourself!
I'm only giving this four stars because I wish there wasn't hyaluronic acid added to every product. I would love to buy this peptide without hyaluronic acid in it.
Absolutely love this product. Works instantly. Applied on a clean face, allow to dry, gives an instant healthy glow even under make up. Have definitely bought more.

I've noticed my skin has been dull over the past year or so even though my routine is unchanged. In just 2 weeks of use I've seen tremendous improvement in overall skin appearance; using on my lips under balm and they are fuller and smoother now.

I just finished my first bottle and I really like this product. It makes my skin look smoother and just better. I'm 31 and don't have noticeable wrinkles yet, but I did have some very fine wrinkles in my forehead which are now gone, as well as some fine lines under my eyes - those are not gone, unfortunately. I still feel like this is an excellent prevention treatment. I will keep purchasing it and hopefully will come back in a few years to tell you that I still don't have any lines ;)

I'm 60+ and have been using this product on my neck for a little over 2 years and have definitely seen improvement. I've purchased several bottles from my local Ulta, but for some reason they don't want to carry it anymore and I had to drive a good distance to buy the last 2 bottles on the shelf at another Ulta. What's up with that? I'm not buying it enough at my local store?

First, confession, I am over 50 and have never taken care of my skin. After asking a friend at work about her skincare, because hers looked AMAZING, she told me she had been a skincare consultant in the past. When I asked for a recommendation she said The Ordinary had the best quality, and a great price. I logged in and took the quiz, since I had no clue where to start. I bought the products it recommended: Squalene Cleanser, Matrixyl, Squalene serum, and Natural Moisturing Factors HA, I added the AHA/BHA mask also. I decided to wait until I was done with the first batch of product to write any review. I was not expecting fast results, but hoped for the best. I can now say at about a month in that the results are awesome! I am watching my pores shrink, the dryness, uneven skin tone, and fine lines are all visibly improving. I use the mask twice a week and the other products twice a day. Can't express how thrilled I am! There is hope! Even if you have neglected your skin forever :)
I like how evenly and easily this goes on. I'm going to mix other serums with it so that it spreads out better to cover my face.

I have sensitive skin, but few wrinkles for my age. To prevent more Agireline and HA with Vit C Serum and SPF50 and Matrixyl then 10min later Retinol in Squalane at night. THANK YOU ORDINARY AND ULTA!!!

avis.titre: Works well, but takes a lot of time
avis.texte: I'm 28, I have dry sensitive skin, and rather pronounced dynamic lines on my forehead. The lines were there since I was a teen, just a skin feature of active facial expressions I guess. In the last couple of (very stressful) years these lines got deeper and longer, across all my forehead. I tried multiple products and this one is the best so far. It took a couple of months until I noticed the results. My lines smoothened out, not completely of course, but they are far less noticeable. Strange enough it didn't seem to affect my smile lines or area around the eye so much. However, once I'm out of this product, it seems like the lines are coming back, so I will keep using this for now. With TO it's hit or miss for me, multipeptide serum breaks me out very quick, and argireline did nothing, so one just has to find the product that matches ones' skin.

avis.titre: Great for the neck and chest area
avis.texte: I read Matrixyl was good for firming up the neck area, and this works wonderfully! I already have a nice neck but am beginning to see some sagging. This stuff truly firms and I use it only on my neck and chest area. I put a sunscreen over it (an SPF 50) after i let in sink in about 15-20 minutes. I use rx Retinal only at night and this during the day- no problems!!

Excellent especially when used with Argireline Solution 10%, as reviewed on the Internet, the combination blocks formation of wrinkles around the eyes. Three drops of Matrixyl to three drops of Argireline. My dermatologist introduced me to The Ordinary and have been using many of their products for years.

Ive never used anti wrinkle products before because i didnt need it before. Im 18 and i realized that my forehead began to get wrinkles and im too young for all that so the orindary was the first thing i wanted to expierement with since ive heard very good things about it. In about a month, the wrinkles on my forhead had disappeared completely! when i smile it got rid of lines and it just works so well overall. This is my first anti againg serum and i dont need anything else!
Past my mid 30s, and this eliminated the dynamic wrinkles on my forehead. I apply this in the morning after cleansing/showering. Then spf on top, no piling. Highly recommend!

I've been using this for about three months and it worked really well for my skin. I have noticed that the lines around my eyes, lips and forehead are smaller and they are not as deep as they used to be, they used to show more when wearing foundation and make up but that's not the case now! My skin look smoother overall and I'm really satisfied, can't wait to try other products from TO!

avis.titre: It did not work for me.
avis.texte: I used it as per the instruction but I did not see any difference. The squalane ones worked though so I am going back to that.
If I could only pick one serum to use for the rest of my life this would be it. Really helped diminish the dynamic lines on my forehead.

I added this into my ordinary routine. I am 37 and use a number of The Ordinary products. I believe this is clogging my pores, especially on my forehead and around my mouth. I have painful breakouts that I haven't had in years. I will be returning this and picking up another bottle of one the other amazing Ordinary products!!

okay, so this unique little co has been purchased by Estee Lauder. ESTEE LAUDER is the parent co. Corporations value profits usually above everything else. Numerous products I have used have been altered and I don't use them any more because really, I'd rather pay more money for a product that works well rather than something that is subpar. I'm 57 and this plumps up my wrinkles like no other serum and I'm super skeptical with beauty products. PLEASE DO NOT CHANGE THIS.

I bought Niacinamide 10% + zinc 1%, Matrixyl 10% + HA and Retinol 1% in squalane to use together after reading previous reviews and I've only been using for about a week and I am truly amazed and so happy with the results so far! Turning 38 in a couple of week and after having quite a troubling and stressful year my skin has been starting to show the signs of the stress I've been under and dropping on this company totally by chance has been the best thing. I've been really conscience of my glabellar line and tired eyes and general dullness to my skin and I've already seen a difference in the severity of my fine lines and my skin feels firmer and healthy and completely blemish free!! Very happy customer and the fact they are amazingly priced is just the cherry on the top! Will defo be reordering but won't need to for awhile yet as alittle goes a long way! The Original, you are my new fave brand...thank you 😊
I didnt notice much change with fine lines but has worked wonders for congestion.

avis.titre: Wish this was available without HA
avis.texte: I love the ingredients and have been using this product for the past few years and saw improvements fairly quickly. I live in a very Phoenix, and it is really dry here. Not only is the climate dry, the air conditioning also dries out the indoor air. HA doesn't work in a dry climate and can actually pull the moisture from your skin. so a few hours into the day, my skins feels parched. HA is all the rage now, but it isn't appropriate for everyone. I still use this product but have to go through several steps to try to minimize the HA effect. I would urge the ordinary to consider making a formula without the HA for those of us in dry climates.

avis.titre: Used for a month, no effect and clogged pores
avis.texte: I was really looking forward to trying this product considering positive reviews and I know every skin is different but on mine it just didn't work and on top of it, it clogs my pores - I have never had that many clogged pores, never on forehead! It must be some ingredient or ingredients that are causing it.
Easy to use website helps to build a regime. Hyaluronic acid serum makes my skin feel great and look tighter. Great price too which is just a bonus.
Noticed forehead and eye wrinkles had smoothed after just days! Couldn't believe it since it was so Inexpensive. Definitely worth a try.

I saw zero results even after daily use. It pills regardless of application method, order, or how long I waited before applying other skincare. Finally tossed it in the trash. Will not be repurchasing. Would not recommend.
I just started using this the other day and I can already see a difference. I'm so happy with it.

avis.titre: Is lightweight and plumps the skin
avis.texte: I've been using this for 2 weeks and the results have been great. My skin looks healthy and plump. I also appreciate how little you have to use to get results. One and half drops is all I use, any more than that and my skin gets really sticky
Sooooooooooo sticky and extremely tacky. The opposite to what hydration feels like! I I'll have to stop immediately

The Ordinary delivers high quality products at a great price. This one did not live up to its description or my expectations. Used daily as directed. Saw no improvement in fine lines. Would not recommend or repurchase.

I'm 51 and have been using Matrixyl and Hyaluronic Acid morning and night for 5 months. My skin is firmer, I have fewer fine lines, and my forehead wrinkles are less noticeable. I met up with some friends from high school recently and they noticed the results right away.

avis.titre: Feels amazing and my skin looks pretty!
avis.texte: I love this product but I also have the Buffet serum and noticed it already has some of the same ingredients that I purchased separately. Should I bother using the other ones separately with the Buffet serum or am I wasting my time? Can I use it with theMandelic acid.?

I use this a couple times a week now before applying Night Cream. I use the glycolic toner one night, this the next & squalane the 3rd after micro-exfoliating with the DermaE's best seller to hydrate. This every 3 day cycle has people literally stopping me on the street to tell me how beautiful my skin is. I'm almost 50 & SM going through menopause so I always feel like I can't get enough moisture but since starting this & using Strivectin's Anti-Wrinkle/Scar cream everyday, it's wonderful.

it doesn't break me out in any way. feels smooth and i did notice a difference. I use it with the rose oil at night and under my moisturizer in the a.m. my skin looks smooth, and the pigmentation is more even before i put on any make up. love it! will try other products from them

I'm a huge fan of The Ordinary's products. I purchased this product to address fine lines around my eyes, mouth, and on my neck. The serum is hydrating. Dropper works as expected. However, I've used as directed but have seen no results. Will not be repurchasing.

From what I read, this tech encourages production of collagen which promotes elasticity. There is definitely a noticeable difference, even though my skin wasn't in drastic need of help (been in using niacinamide and HA for the last few years regularly). I am curious as the effects of using it after applying the Hylamide Sub Q Mist which contains GLUCURONIC ACID....as I have noticed some breakouts around my face. Not sure if it's just purge or irritation.

I am so sad to see that The Ordinary has put Peg-50 in their bottles. I had trusted them to be clean but this chemical is a known carcinogen. Very sad. There are other brands out with matrixyl that does not use that Pegs.

avis.titre: This has been magical for my skin!
avis.texte: Last year, my resolution was to invest in good skincare. I watched a lot of YouTube reviews and tutorials, and settled on The Ordinary because everyone loves it and it's affordable. I started with the squalene cleanser and hyaluronic acid, and gradually added more, until I now feel I have found the right routine. I am 59 years old, and thankfully look younger, but I was troubled by dryness and fine lines. Now that I am using hyaluronic acid, Granactive Retinoid and Matrixyl together each night, and Matrixyl / hyaluronic acid in the am (plus moisturizer), I see SUCH a difference! My skin is glowy, and the lines are not as noticeable; I actually looked in the mirror the first thing this morning and was startled at how good my skin looked WITHOUT MAKEUP. I am a very happy customer!

avis.titre: It works for me for acne
avis.texte: I was using this for a few months, usually I get at least one pimple when it's that time of the month but I didn't .. recently I ran out and a few days later … saw a pimple :-/ purchasing asap

I recently upgraded my assault on my fine lines and uneven skin tone (thanks to not wearing sunscreen in my younger years) by adding Tretinoin 0.1%. I was having lots of dryness and flaking so I began to mix TO Matrixyl 10% + HA and am shocked by the results! Using this combo I've seen a 90% improvement in just one week. The only area flaking is the side of my nose, which makes sense as this skin is very thin. Also has drastically improved sensitivity from the Tretinoin. I'll never go without this. Took one star off due to the thickness/tackiness which isn't great under makeup.

J'utilise ce produit depuis peu. Impossible de ce maquiller après. Sur ma peau, le produit pèle, bouloche et colle. Je l'ai essayé seul avec une crème hydratante et je l'ai essayé avec hyaluronic acide 2%+b5. Et pareil. Pouvez-vous me dire s'il vous plaît si il y a un ordre ou si il faut utiliser chaque sérum seul. Bien sûr avec une crème hydratante pour sceller. Merci de me répondre car je suis très déçu. J'applique également 2 fois par semaine du retiniol 0,2%. Merci pour tous vos avis et réponses

This is some sort of black magic - I had (key word) a forehead wrinkle that had become static and was scheduled for a filler consult. After a week (!!) of 2x daily use the wrinkle is no longer static and barely there when I try to make it visible. WIll never stop using!

avis.titre: Good product, not clear about conflicts?
avis.texte: The product was effective, skin feels hydrated and plump. I would give it 5 stars if it didn't have HAluronic acid. Question - Can I use it in one AM routine together with The Ordinary Argeraline and NIOD Survival? I am confused because I saw The Ordinary not recommending to use peptides together with antioxidants, but maybe it was only the Resveratrol>? Anyhow, does this combination have any conflicts? Argeraline + Matrixyl + NIOD Survival? Please let me know, I cannot find this anywhere.
Over 50, some deep wrinkles. Only had a few weeks to use this, but already seeing more glowing skin.

It's truly amazing! I like to use it morning and in the evening. Sometimes I even skip my moisturizer over it. It makes a huge difference in my skins firmness, and overall appearance. I absolutely love this serum!
I've been using Matrixyl daily for about 6 months now, and I like how it makes my skin look more supple and therefore younger.
Works great. Removes fine lines and give my skin a healthy glow. I use it every as my morning routine.

avis.titre: With the argiline. Smoker lines disapearing
avis.texte: Please don't come after me, - I smoked for over 28 years. This combined with the argireline solution has had the most significant impact on my fine lines, in just over two weeks. I have also had issues with retnoids, retinols, sunscreens, you name it. If it has been marketed to make your wrinkles disappear, seems to work for everyone else, it just makes mine worse or agitates my skin. I have been using the argireline solution, matrixyl, then putting a very small amount of Vaseline over top my forehead and eye area. I was using the squaline oil instead of the Vaseline but it was too light and dissipated too quickly ( although it is excellent for hair or a light body/ nail moisturizer). I do very much like that oil, it did not bother my facial skin whatsoever. I should note I had first purchased the argireline solution and was using that for two weeks prior to adding this. It was very nice on its own ( very light, watery formula), however adding this and covering with the Vaseline has definitely kicked it up a notch. I am still looking for a substitute oil/cream instead of the Vaseline but everything else seems to either not be heavy duty enough ( to hold it in overnight ) or contradict ( can not use acids and such with this ).

This is the type of product that you may not think has an effect...until you've been without it for a month or two and you suddenly realise you look like a withered husk that has blown in from the Sahara. In just a week of starting to use it again, my skin is plumper and more radiant and my under-eye area, which is my area of concern, looks a lot less lined. I use this on my entire face, including around my lips and eyes, every day before sunblock and makeup. It's not greasy, doesn't affect my foundation and REALLY makes a difference in my skin. 10/10 recommended.

The jury is still out on this one. I am looking to firm my skin and treat some fine lines so that is going to take a bit to see if this formula helps. I will say that it is super hydrating and goes well under other products.

I was looking for products that would plump my 65-year-old skin and soften lines. I purchased Matrixyl 10% & HA as well as Buffet. Before bed, after washing my face and neck, I applied a diluted retinol solution that I have been using for over a year. While my skin was still damp, I applied Matrixyl and Buffet and let them absorb into the skin. Immediately my skin felt hydrated. In the morning, when I woke up and looked in the mirror, it was just, WOW! My skin was plump and glowing. My facial and neck lines were markedly softened. My skin feels soft, plumped up and it glows. I am amazed! These are great products that deliver results and don't cost a fortune. I'm hooked! If you are fence sitting regarding whether or not to purchase these products, go ahead and give them a try. I am very pleased with the results. Pros: Requires very little product, easy to use, price, nice ingredients. Cons: None.

I have tried so many different hyaluronic acid formulas from somebody different companies, and I have never found anything to work as wonderfully as this product. A little bummed that I can't use it with vitamin C, but have been combining it with a different antioxidant, and I have glowing, clear skin.

avis.titre: Perhaps this works if you're young
avis.texte: I've stuck with this for a year. Unfortunately, I've found past age 65, there's nothing miraculous or anything that makes much of a difference. (I'm back to limited botox for forehead.) I love Marine Hyalauronics and the Squalenes. I also use glycerine with B12 serum. Fortunately, I have hereditarily good skin. No fine lines around eyes, no deep marionettes. Just chin wrinkles, but I refuse fillers or lasers! If anyone has good advice for us over 65 babes, do tell!
Loving this product so far as we come out of winter. Wondering if it will make my skin sensitive to sun exposure however? Anyone have any experience with this?

avis.titre: I use the whole line of products
avis.texte: I have tried multiple products in the past. Recently started using multiple Ordinary products. Have built on my skin care regimen. Love this! Ordinary is a great product that does not break the bank. I now have my two sons using this line as well
I use this product for 2 years now, mostly i mix it with Niacinamide Powder and use it in AM - and i love how my skin feels.
